rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something suggested but not yet approved or carried out.

example.english: This is the proposed new arrangement, and it has not been formally implemented yet.
example.traditional: 呢個係建議嘅新安排，仲未正式落實。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 gin3 ji6 ge3 san1 on1 paai4 zung6 mei6 zing3 sik1 lok6 sat6

rows.note: Use this for something still being planned, especially a project, arrangement, or budget that has not yet been implemented.

example.english: The new building is a proposed project, and construction has not started yet.
example.traditional: 呢座新大樓係計劃中嘅項目，仲未動工。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 san1 daai6 lau4 hai6 gei3 waak6 zung1 ge3 hong6 muk6 zung6 mei6 dung6 gung1
